foreignerComparison.title: How does this compare to your home climate?

uk.name: United Kingdom
uk.comparisonNote: Chennai's summer heat is far more intense than the UK's warmest days
uk.monsoonNote: No monsoon season; rainfall is spread fairly evenly across the year.
uk.extremeNote: Rare heatwaves above 30°C, becoming more frequent in recent years.

us.name: United States
us.comparisonNote: Chennai's cyclone season is comparable to the US Gulf Coast hurricane season
us.monsoonNote: The Southwest has a summer 'monsoon' with short, intense storms; most of the US has no true monsoon.
us.extremeNote: Hurricanes affect the Gulf and East Coasts from June to November.

ca.name: Canada
ca.comparisonNote: Chennai never sees snow or freezing temperatures, unlike most of Canada's winter
ca.extremeNote: Harsh winters with heavy snowfall and sub-zero temperatures for months.

jp.name: Japan
jp.comparisonNote: Japan's typhoon season closely parallels Chennai's Northeast monsoon and cyclone risk
jp.monsoonNote: Has a rainy season called 'tsuyu' in June–July, similar timing to India's monsoon.
jp.extremeNote: Typhoons regularly hit Japan from August to October.

au.name: Australia
au.comparisonNote: Australia's seasons are reversed — their summer matches Chennai's cooler months
au.monsoonNote: Northern Australia has a wet/dry monsoon season similar to India's.
au.extremeNote: Bushfires are a major risk during hot, dry summers.
